title: Your Advice and Changes
author: SalivaSpittingWorm
selftext:
Hi, everyone. First, I want to say thank you to everyone who gave me advice or suggested changes in previous threads.

I changed the little bird’s gait based on the suggestion that the chick was walking too calmly, so I tried to make it look more like a chick. Another thing was the new background. I got a lot of advice—to be honest, I liked the orange-toned versions better, but something about them still didn’t sit right with me, even though most of the feedback was that people preferred the brown-toned versions. But I didn’t really like that one. So I completely redesigned the background, adding more contrast. And now I really like it. Thank you, everyone.

Finally, some feedback on the bar. Honestly, I liked it, but it was true that it was too bright, so I just toned down the color. Now it’s more balanced. So what do you think of the changes? By the way, the first location will also be getting some changes. :)
